hypotheses.D2_same_family_directions_beat_generic_t: Same-family donors exceed the eight-direction random-token baseline in native fidelity by at least 0.03 with pair-bootstrap interval above zero in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.D3_same_family_directions_recover_the_na: Same-family donor native fidelity is within 0.03 of the actual natural edit in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.D4_same_family_directions_prefer_native_: The prospective router chooses native at least 0.10 more often for same-family than different-family donors in every layer/corpus cell.
